english_title: Theorem 1.2: A Variant of the Identity Theorem for Continuous Functions
statement_en: Let $f,g:X\to Y$ be continuous maps from a topological space $X$ to a Hausdorff ordered topological space $Y$, and assume the order relation is compatible with the topology in the sense that $\{(y_1,y_2)\in Y\times Y:y_1\leq y_2\}$ is closed. If $$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in Z$$ for some dense subset $Z\subset X$, then $$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in X.$$
callout_body:
假设映射$f,g:X\to Y$是从拓扑空间$X$到$Y$的两个连续映射，其中$Y$是Hausdroff的有序拓扑空间,并且其上的序关系"$\leq$"与拓扑是相容的，即集合$\{(y_1,y_2)\in Y\times Y:y_1\leq y_2\}$是一个闭集。

那么如果两个函数$$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in Z$$其中$Z\subset X$是一个稠密子集。那么$$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in X$$
